title: EntityDescriptor
description: Describes a dynamic entity. An entity is the runtime data model: it defines a table-like aggregate, its properties, validations, parent-child relation, attachment support, and create/update/delete interceptors.
markdownDescription: AI guidance: create one entity per aggregate/root concept. Use a stable namespace-style `name` such as `Acme.Crm.Customer`; this name is referenced by pages, forms, foreign keys, dashboards, scripts, and permissions. Put user-facing labels in `displayName`; choose `displayProperty` as a short string property used by lookups. Use `parent` only for child/detail entities that belong to a parent record. Set `app` only when the entity belongs to a non-default low-code app. Reverse relationship access is configured on page `relationships`, not on the entity.

$schema.description: Optional schema reference used when this descriptor is stored as a model descriptor file.

name.description: Stable full name of the entity, usually Namespace.Module.EntityName (for example 'Acme.Crm.Customer'). Must be unique within its app across all model layers. Do not rename after data exists unless a migration/rename flow is intended.

app.description: Name of the low-code app that owns this entity. Omit for the default app. Must match an apps[].name; app-scoped entities are addressed at runtime as '<app>:<EntityName>'.

displayName.description: Default plural/screen label for this entity (for example 'Customers'). Page menu titles are configured separately on page descriptors.

description.description: Optional description for designer documentation and model health context.

order.description: Optional sort order used by the designer and generated menus/lists when listing entities. Lower values appear first.

displayProperty.description: Property name used when another entity references this entity in a lookup/autocomplete. Prefer a required string property such as 'Name', 'Title', or 'Code'. Defaults to 'Id' when omitted.

parent.description: Full name of the parent entity for parent-child/detail entities. When set, records of this entity are scoped under the parent and the runtime adds a '<ParentEntityName>Id' foreign key property automatically.

extendsLowerLayer.description: When true, this descriptor extends an entity with the same name defined in a lower model layer (for example code-first attributes or the defaults layer) instead of defining a new entity. Only the overridden fields need to be present.

attachments.description: Record-level attachment settings. Use this for multiple arbitrary files attached to a record; use File/Image properties for first-class file fields.

properties.description: Entity properties. Omit framework audit/id fields such as Id, CreationTime, CreatorId, LastModificationTime, IsDeleted unless intentionally overriding metadata; the runtime supplies standard fields.

crossFieldValidations.description: Entity-level validation rules that compare two properties from the same entity. Use for date ranges, matching password fields, numeric min/max pairs, and other cross-field rules.

interceptors.description: Create/Update/Delete command interceptors. Use Pre interceptors to validate, normalize, or block a command; use Post interceptors for side effects after persistence.
